rule: R2 passes when the judged share is no lower than the control share minus quality.jury.maxShareGap (0.2)
note: It passes by the rule: 0 of 15 on the judged pictures against 0 of 10 on the control, and the judged share is no lower than the control share less 0.2. All 25 jurors answered between 05:52Z and 05:54Z, none replaced. No juror chose (a) or (b) for any picture. The two approved controls were called an ordinary 3D render (c) by all ten of their jurors; the three judged pictures were called a web demo or app (d) by twelve of fifteen and (c) by three, all three on the key `boss-fight`. So the rule is met, and the build still reads as an app screen more often than the approved images do.
